influences.name: Night of the Demon (film)
influences.context: "Hounds of Love". Well, again this was written at home, this was an early song. And it was inspired in some ways by this old black and white movie that is a real favorite of ours, called Night of the Demon.

influences.name: Peter Reich
influences.context: This was very special to me because it was all inspired by a book that I found years ago... And it was this beautiful story by this guy called Peter Reich. And it's all about his view of his father, but through the eyes of a child, so it was all about his childhood and how he saw his father as this incredibly magical figure.

influences.name: Pink Floyd
influences.context: Couldn't get a helicopter anywhere and in the end I asked permission to use the helicopter from The Wall from The Floyd, it was the best helicopter I'd heard for years for years [laughs].

influences.name: Nosferatu (film)
influences.context: And I'd had this idea to put a vocal piece in there, that was like this traditional tune I'd heard used in the film Nosferatu.

influences.name: The Trio Bulgarka
influences.context: Just getting up the courage to get in touch with The Trio Bulgarka took me a long time. I wanted to preserve the sense of how precious they were

influences.name: Stephen King
influences.context: I think The Shining is terrific; it's the only book by Stephen King I've read. Its atmosphere ended up in a couple of songs, and Get Out Of My House (from The Dreaming) was very inspired by it.

influences.name: Jack Clayton
influences.context: There was The Innocents (adapted from Henry Jame's ghost story The Turn Of The Screw and directed in 1961 by Jack Clayton, starring Deborah Kerr and Michael Redgrave), which I saw when I was a kid. It was so strong, and years later I wrote The Infant Kiss.

influences.name: Jacques Tourneur
influences.context: There's an old horror film called Night Of The Demon (adapted from M.R. James short story Casting The Runes and directed in 1957 by Jacques Tourneur, starring Dana Andrews and Peggy Cummins) and that very much inspired Hounds Of Love.

influences.name: Peter Richardson
influences.context: I'd seen Strike (another Comic Strip special), and I was very impressed by the look and Peter Richardson's direction. What those guys do is very special

influences.name: Brian Eno
influences.context: Brian Eno and David Byrne's My Life In The Bush Of Ghosts ("tremendously influential on me and the whole of modern music with the repetition and sampling")
